health.readinessLabel: Not ready to launch — strong progress, a few hard gates
health.plainSummary: As of today’s software build (10 Sep 2026), HelgoIQ launch readiness sits around half. Privacy checks are the strongest area — most studio-isolation tests already pass. Command Centre Cluster A is nearly done, and AI and ambient features have been probed widely. The hard gates are clear: the Data Migration upload screen still crashes so the twelve-month test dataset cannot load; a new member cannot accept their invite (smoke fails at step one); four privacy leaks remain; and Platform Admin still needs to settle AI Feature Controls and the Event Bus. Approving PR #1232 and importing the dataset after it deploys is the single biggest unlock for data, AI re-scores, and confidence overall.
strengths: Studio privacy checks mostly green (25 of 29 pass)
Command Centre Cluster A nearly complete (20 of 24)
AI feature list well underway (48 of 85 already pass)
Ambient intelligence deep-dive done with clear known fails
Twelve-month CSV prepared and earlier import fix already live

Clerk invite failure blocks critical-path smoke
AI Feature Controls / Event Bus waiting on Platform Admin
Clusters B–F banks not yet approved or rejected
